content: Compounding error math: 20-step process at 95% per-step reliability succeeds only 36% of time; worst multi-agent risk is one agent's subtly-wrong output treated as ground truth downstream, self-coherent but systematically wrong. Agent drift affects long-running agents (studies project ~42% task-success reduction, 3.2x more human intervention). Required observability: trace reasoning chains, log every decision (input/reasoning/output/impact), track memory references, tool usage, intermediate outputs; selective autonomy — aggressive automation for low-risk, strict oversight for high-stakes.
